text: 创业板指半日跌近1%，PCB概念股逆势走强。 恒指半日跌0.4%，恒生科技指数跌1.5%，华虹宏力跌超5%。 受美股存储大跌影响，韩股跌超7%，连续第二日大跌，SK海力士跌近8%；日经225指数跌超2%。 IMF小幅上调2026年全球GDP增长预期；IMF称全球金融稳定面临三大风险，主权债收益率急剧上升。 中国央行批准威士公司筹备银行卡清算机构。 硅料龙头杭州闭门会约定硅料含税底价？回应：消息属实，同步划定电池片报价底线。 报道：DeepSeek将在近期完成最新一轮融资，融资金额从此前计划的500亿元增至约1000亿元。 升级个人AI助理，千问将推出Pe
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell nearly 1% at midday, while PCB concept stocks strengthened against the trend. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.4% at midday, the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.5%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor fell more than 5%. Affected by the sharp decline in US memory stocks, South Korean stocks fell more than 7%, dropping sharply for the second consecutive day, with SK Hynix down nearly 8%; the Nikkei 225 fell more than 2%. The IMF slightly raised its 2026 global GDP growth forecast; the IMF said global financial stability faces three major risks, with sovereign bond yields rising sharply. China's central bank approved Visa Inc. to prepare a bank card clearing institution. A closed-door meeting in Hangzhou of leading polysilicon producers agreed on a tax-inclusive floor price for polysilicon? Response: The news is true, and a floor price for solar cell quotations was also set. Report: DeepSeek will complete its latest funding round in the near term, with the financing amount increasing from the previously planned 50 billion yuan to about 100 billion yuan.
